identity.description: Checks a DOI (or a paper title from the ADA knowledge base) for retraction / validity status. LLM-free and instant. Heuristic check: flags known retracted DOIs and "retracted" markers; it is not an external registry lookup yet.

inputs.description: A DOI to check (e.g. "10.1103/PhysRevE.112") or a paper title from the ADA knowledge base

outputs.description: Retraction / validity status of the DOI
The matching knowledge-base paper, when found, as structured JSON
